author: imryaan
body:
So recently I think everyone has noticed that avilag is just even worse that it was before.

In one game i place about 10 blocks and 1 block actually stays.
Lagbacks are just even more common now and they happen when you really dont want them to eg : When bridging to a monument 
Floating players and nametags above your head are just really annoying and lag you everywhere.
When you get shot off a bridge you go into the void and you get teleported back up which is just weird.
Every now and then in the time between different when the map cycles the game just freezes but everyone can talk.
Throwback spends most of its time offline. :(

When will you ever think about fixing this?
